confidence_notes: Holistic model estimates for July 2026 peak season, not checked against live listings or booking pages. Restaurant and coffee anchors are more reliable than hotel and hostel rates, which swing with summer demand. Cocktail and wine are bounded from typical French bar and restaurant pricing relative to beer. FX is from an RBA-attributed search snippet for 15 Oct 2026; the RBA page itself was not opened directly.
comparable_city_reasoning: Mid-sized French Mediterranean cities with similar tourism demand, such as Nice, Montpellier, and Toulon, with Marseille priced somewhat below Nice and in line with Montpellier.
